commitMessage:
Add support for multiple embedding models with comprehensive demos

- Enhanced embeddings_demo.py to support multiple SentenceTransformers models
- Added huggingface_embeddings_demo.py for direct Hugging Face Transformers models
- Added openai_embeddings_demo.py for OpenAI embedding models
- Enhanced ollama_embedding.py to support multiple Ollama models
- Added EMBEDDING_MODELS.md with comprehensive documentation on all models
- Added command-line arguments for model selection in all demos
